key_insight: CoCoGraph is a collaborative constrained graph diffusion model that generates novel molecules guaranteed to be chemically valid and more realistic than state-of-the-art outputs, while using up to an order of magnitude fewer parameters and delivering faster sampling.
problem_solved: Generative molecular models often produce invalid or unrealistic molecules and require large, slow models; this paper addresses reliable, realistic, and parameter-efficient molecular graph generation.
method: Graph diffusion framework that denoises and constructs molecular graphs directly in graph space while respecting chemical constraints (e.g., valence and bonding rules).
Collaborative architecture of modules that jointly predict graph structure and enforce constraints during sampling to guarantee validity and improve realism.
Parameter-efficient design and sampling strategy that reduces model size and speeds up generation by up to an order of magnitude versus prior state-of-the-art.
impact: Practitioners can generate high-quality, chemically valid molecules with far less compute and smaller models, enabling faster iteration in drug discovery, materials design, and other cheminformatics applications.
visual_elements: Schematic of the graph diffusion pipeline showing denoising steps, constraint enforcement, and collaborative modules.
Before/after examples: side-by-side molecule examples from a baseline model vs CoCoGraph highlighting improved realism and validity.
Bar chart comparing validity rate, realism score, generation speed, and parameter count vs state-of-the-art models.
Iconic workflow diagram linking input objectives → CoCoGraph generation → validated candidate molecules for downstream screening.
paper_title: A collaborative constrained graph diffusion model for the generation of realistic synthetic molecules
paper_authors: Manuel Ruiz-Botella, Marta Sales-Pardo, Roger Guimerà
